item.tib: bstan srung g.yung drung dgra 'dul rtsal gyi rno mthong gsal ba'i sgron me
item.coloph: de ltar las la brag btsan gyi/ rno mthong gsal ba'i sgron me 'di/ legs nyes spyod pa'i sgrab gshen gyi/ snying nor dam pa 'chang byas na/ kun rdzob don dang 'gal mi 'gyur/ de skad shar rdza 'od lus pa'i/ rgyal tshab blo gros rgya mtshos bris/ sarba dzayan+tu//
